# Sentra

> IoT structural health monitoring for bridges, railways, buildings, dams,
> tunnels and water infrastructure. Sentra designs and deploys wireless sensor
> networks, data loggers, laser scanning and digital twins, with analytics that
> turn continuous tilt, strain, vibration, displacement and scour readings into
> decisions about structures in service. Based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh,
> India; part of Clove Technologies. Authorised India reseller for Worldsensing
> and XGRIDS.

Sentra sells instrumentation and monitoring programmes to infrastructure owners,
EPC contractors and consultants. Deployments include Indian Railways bridges,
highway structures, high-rise buildings, dams, ports and mining slopes.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: request it with
Accept: text/markdown, or just swap the .html for .md.

This site is documentation and marketing content only. There is no public API,
no agent tool endpoint and no authenticated interface; /api/ is an internal
backend for the site's own chatbot and is disallowed in robots.txt.

## Solutions

What Sentra delivers, by discipline.

- [Advanced Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)](https://sentratech.in/solutions/advanced-non-destructive-testing-ndt.html): Ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle and other NDT methods to find subsurface defects without shutting down operations
- [Asset Monitoring & Management Solutions](https://sentratech.in/solutions/asset-monitoring-and-management-solutions.html): IoT sensors and dashboards for monitoring manufacturing, utility and mining assets, with predictive maintenance alerts
- [Bridge Inspection & Condition Assessment](https://sentratech.in/solutions/bridge-inspection-and-condition-assessment.html): Drone surveys, NDT and AI analysis for bridge inspection
- [Consulting & Advisory Services](https://sentratech.in/solutions/consulting-and-advisory-services.html): Vendor-neutral consulting for structural monitoring, asset management and digital engineering
- [Digital Engineering & Documentation](https://sentratech.in/solutions/digital-engineering-and-documentation.html): ISO 19650-aligned BIM, scan-to-BIM, digital twin, and asset information management services that build a lasting digital foundation for your..
- [Digital Twin Solutions](https://sentratech.in/solutions/digital-twin.html): Sentra's Digital Twin solutions integrate BIM, IoT sensors and real-time analytics to create virtual replicas of physical assets for infrastructure..
- [Fatigue & Residual Life Assessment](https://sentratech.in/solutions/fatigue-and-residual-life-assessment.html): Engineering-grade fatigue and residual life assessment for bridges, steel structures and offshore platforms — quantify remaining life and extend..
- [Geotechnical & Foundation Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/solutions/geotechnical-and-foundation-monitoring.html): Real-time geotechnical and foundation monitoring for construction sites, tunnels and slopes — sub-millimetre precision, 24/7 ground intelligence
- [Structural Health Monitoring Services](https://sentratech.in/solutions/structural-health-monitoring.html): Real-time structural health monitoring using IoT sensors, edge analytics and predictive ML to detect anomalies, reduce downtime and extend asset life

## Industries

The same capabilities framed by sector.

- [Bridge & Highway Structure Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/bridges-highways-monitoring.html): Continuous displacement, strain and inclination monitoring for bridges and highway structures using Sentra's wireless IoT sensors and edge analytics
- [Building & High-Rise Structural Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/buildings-highrise-monitoring.html): Settlement monitoring, tilt tracking and seismic response systems for residential, commercial and heritage buildings using Sentra's IoT sensor..
- [Construction & Tunnelling Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/construction-tunnelling-monitoring.html): Real-time deformation, convergence and vibration control during deep excavation, tunnelling and high-rise construction phases using Sentra's IoT..
- [Dam & Reservoir Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/dams-reservoirs-monitoring.html): GNSS-based displacement, pore pressure and seepage monitoring for earthfill, concrete and masonry dams using Sentra's wireless IoT sensor networks
- [Industrial Facility Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/industrial-facilities-monitoring.html): Asset health, predictive maintenance and equipment vibration monitoring for power plants, refineries and process industries using Sentra's IoT..
- [Mining & Geotechnical Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/mining-geotechnical-monitoring.html): Slope stability, subsidence and ground deformation monitoring for open-pit mines, tunnels and retaining structures using Sentra's IoT sensors
- [Port & Marine Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/ports-marine-monitoring.html): Corrosion tracking, jetty tilt and structural load monitoring for quays, wharves and offshore platforms using Sentra's IoT sensors in harsh marine..
- [Railway Infrastructure Monitoring](https://sentratech.in/industries/railway-infrastructure-monitoring.html): Real-time vibration, tilt and dynamic load monitoring for railway tracks, bridges and rail structures using Sentra's IoT sensor networks and edge..

## Products

Hardware: laser scanners, wireless and wired sensors, data loggers, communications.

- [Accelerometer](https://sentratech.in/products/accelerometers.html): Triaxial MEMS accelerometer for vibration, seismic and dynamic motion monitoring with ±16g range, 0.5-250Hz bandwidth, IP65 rated and LoRa..
- [Analog Data Logger](https://sentratech.in/products/analog-data-logger.html): 4-channel wireless analog data logger for voltage, current, Wheatstone bridge and thermistor sensors
- [Core Communications](https://sentratech.in/products/core-communications.html): Deploy robust, secure IoT networks with Sentra's Core Communications — narrowband & broadband gateways, repeaters, and cloud connectivity for..
- [Digital Data Logger](https://sentratech.in/products/digital-data-logger.html): Digital Data Logger — wirelessly stream data from digital sensors using ModBus RTU
- [Edge Devices](https://sentratech.in/products/edge-devices.html): Explore Sentra's edge devices portfolio — rugged sensors, low-power data loggers and gateways for long-term infrastructure monitoring and remote..
- [4G Rugged Gateway](https://sentratech.in/products/gateway.html): Carrier-class 4G LoRaWAN gateway for remote monitoring — IP68, up to 15km range, 1000+ devices per network
- [GNSS Meter](https://sentratech.in/products/gnss-meter.html): High-precision GNSS meter with RTK correction for millimeter-level displacement monitoring
- [Laser Scanners](https://sentratech.in/products/laser-scanners.html): Sentra is the official India reseller for XGRIDS laser scanners — Lixel K2, PortalCam & Lixel L2 Pro
- [Laser Tiltmeter](https://sentratech.in/products/laser-tiltmeter.html): 2-in-1 Laser Distance Meter and 3-axis tiltmeter for sub-millimeter convergence monitoring
- [LCC](https://sentratech.in/products/lcc.html): LCC by XGRIDS — capture, create and share 3D Gaussian Splatting models with Studio, Cloud, Model & Scene Editor, available in India via Sentra
- [Lixel K2](https://sentratech.in/products/lixel-k2.html): Lixel K2 by XGRIDS — lightweight handheld SLAM LiDAR scanner with onboard RTK, 200,000 pts/s, 1cm accuracy and up to 100m range
- [Lixel L2 Pro](https://sentratech.in/products/lixel-l2-pro.html): Lixel L2 Pro by XGRIDS — handheld SLAM LiDAR scanner with dual 48MP panoramic camera, up to 640,000 pts/s and 300m range
- [LixelStudio](https://sentratech.in/products/lixelstudio.html): LixelStudio by XGRIDS — one-click processing from raw scan data to production-ready point clouds, with SLAM mapping and BIM/CAD/GIS export, via..
- [Piconode](https://sentratech.in/products/piconode-data-logger.html): Piconode — ultra-compact wireless data logger for analog sensors
- [PortalCam](https://sentratech.in/products/portalcam.html): PortalCam by XGRIDS — the world's first handheld spatial camera, fusing LiDAR depth, RGB imaging and edge AI for real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting
- [K20 Edge Repeater](https://sentratech.in/products/repeater.html): K20 Edge Repeater extends LoRaWAN coverage underground and through obstacles
- [Strain Gauge](https://sentratech.in/products/strain-gauges.html): Vibrating wire strain gauges for precision stress and deformation measurement on steel, concrete and rock
- [Thread X3](https://sentratech.in/products/thread.html): Thread X3 broadband 4G/LTE node for high-throughput sensor networks
- [Wireless Tiltmeter](https://sentratech.in/products/tiltmeter-event-detection.html): Wireless 3-axis tiltmeter with event detection, edge processing, and up to 10-year battery life
- [Tiltmeter](https://sentratech.in/products/tiltmeter.html): High-accuracy wireless tiltmeter for angular displacement and tilt trends in structures, slopes, and rail tracks
- [Vibrating Wire RCR](https://sentratech.in/products/vibrating-wire-rcr.html): Vibrating Wire RCR — ultra-robust wireless data logger embedded in precast concrete
- [G7 Vibrating Wire Data Logger](https://sentratech.in/products/vibrating-wire.html): G7 Vibrating Wire Data Logger — wirelessly stream data from all leading vibrating wire sensor manufacturers
- [Wireless Vibration Meter](https://sentratech.in/products/vibration-meter.html): Wireless tri-axial vibration meter for automated, long-term structural vibration monitoring
- [Wired Sensors](https://sentratech.in/products/wired-sensors.html): High-precision accelerometers and strain gauges engineered for accurate, reliable structural health monitoring in challenging infrastructure..
